Baked Fish Parcels
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 19, 2009 - 11:38pm

Ingredients




4 Salmon fillets or steaks
1 teaspoon Schwartz Basil
1 ounce Butter, (25g)
4 tablespoons White wine or lemon juice
Schwartz Onion Pepper to sprinkle.

Preparation

1 Preheat the oven to 350F, 180C, Gas Mark 4. Place each fish fillet or steak on an individual piece of foil. Divide the Basil, butter, white wine or lemon juice and Onion Pepper, between the four fillets or steaks before wrapping them in foil and sealing well. Bake for 20-25 minutes until the fish is cooked.
